scope: Cross-period sample explicitly linked to existing GitHub batch finding IDs. Ratings measure ability to write coherent, accurately grounded site explanations rather than bibliographic citation volume.

rating_definitions.substantial: Can write a nuanced, sourced chronological place explanation with multiple independently checked locators and physically verified observations.
rating_definitions.developing: Substantive site-linked chronology and explanatory mechanism exist but primary checks or major interpretive gaps remain.
rating_definitions.sparse: Isolated named specifics or disputed partial evidence, insufficient for complete learning narrative.
rating_definitions.missing: No substantial finding for the proposed period/theme/place crossing, not equivalent to zero source citations.
